description: This file defines constants and configuration values for the MobileFrontend part of a restaurant app, including color schemes, external links, environment keys, and storage keys.

classes.name: BrandColors
classes.description: Contains static color constants for the app's color scheme.

classes.name: ExternalLinks
classes.description: Holds external contact and social media link constants.

classes.name: EnvKeys
classes.description: Defines environment variable keys used for configuration.

classes.name: StorageKeys
classes.description: Specifies keys used for local storage of data.
